text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
An open view stretching as far as the eye 
could see— it almost felt like a waste to 
cross the finish line...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if I'll be able... to reach that 
place again in our next race."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Right. I got 1st place, didn't I? I was so 
lost in the moment...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"I was able to focus on my own running— It 
was a good race."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
That's true. I wanted to keep running for 
longer.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
—Um, Trainer. I'm really looking forward 
to the next race.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Because I still want to keep watching 
you.
